offerings.name: Search (/search, instant)
offerings.pricing: From $4 / 1k requests. $4 / 1k requests (up to 10 results); each result above 10: $1 / 1k results; AI page summaries: $1 / 1k pages
offerings.price_basis: PAYG /search (instant) base price, includes up to 10 results
offerings.free_quota: Free Tier gives you $10 in credits (up to 2,500 Instant searches) the day you sign up, and your free balance resets to $10 on the first of every month. No payment method required. Complete onboarding in the dashboard and your first team earns a one-time $10 bonus.
offerings.output_type: Real-time search with token-efficient page contents;标准搜索结果(URLs and page contents)、Highlights、Structured outputs、streaming AI Summary
offerings.note: Exa Instant 63.6% accuracy / 323ms latency on Web Walker QA. Enterprise: up to 1,000 results per search, custom indexes, SLAs, Zero Data Retention, volume discounts (custom pricing).

offerings.name: Search (/search, fast, auto)
offerings.pricing: $7 / 1k requests (up to 10 results); each result above 10: $1 / 1k results; AI page summaries: $1 / 1k pages
offerings.price_basis: PAYG /search (fast, auto) base price, includes up to 10 results
offerings.output_type: fast 450ms 低延迟默认质量；auto ~1s 自动选择最佳模式；AI Summary (streamable)
offerings.note: auto is an adaptive search type that picks the best mode for each query; described as "The best general-purpose default." Exa Fast 69.6% / 454ms, Exa Auto 67.8% / ~1.2s (Web Walker QA).

offerings.name: Deep Search
offerings.pricing: deep-lite $12 / 1k requests; deep $12 / 1k requests; deep-reasoning $15 / 1k requests (each up to 10 results)
offerings.price_basis: PAYG deep-lite / deep (base price up to 10 results); deep-reasoning $15 / 1k
offerings.output_type: Multi-step research with structured outputs and citations
offerings.note: Set with type on /search. Latency: deep-lite ~4s; deep 4–15s; deep-reasoning 12–40s. Additional results and AI page summaries cost the same as standard search. Exa Deep 80.0% / 4.3s avg (Web Walker QA).

offerings.name: Answer
offerings.price_basis: PAYG /answer base price, includes up to 10 results
offerings.output_type: An LLM answer to a question, with citations
offerings.note: Endpoint /answer. No per-extra-result or AI page summary surcharge listed.

offerings.name: Monitors
offerings.pricing: $15 / 1k requests (up to 10 results); each result above 10: $1 / 1k results; AI page summaries: $1 / 1k pages
offerings.price_basis: PAYG /monitors base price, includes up to 10 results
offerings.output_type: Scheduled searches that surface new events on the web

offerings.name: Contents
offerings.pricing: $1 / 1k pages, per content type; AI page summaries $1 / 1k pages
offerings.price_basis: PAYG /contents per page, billed per content type (text, highlights, summary each billed separately)
offerings.output_type: Full page text, highlights, and summaries for known URLs
offerings.note: Not a discovery search endpoint: operates on known URLs. One page with text and highlights counts as two content types.

offerings.name: Agent
offerings.pricing: $0.012–$1.00 / fixed-effort run, or usage-based. minimal $0.012/request; low $0.025/request; medium $0.10/request; high $0.50/request; xhigh $1.00/request. Metered: Agent Compute Units $0.10 / ACU; Search tool calls $0.005 / search; Email contact enrichment $0.02 / email; Phone contact enrichment $0.07 / phone number
offerings.output_type: Async deep research, list building, and enrichment
offerings.note: No flat per-1k-request rate; billed per ACU/tool call/enrichment unit. auto defaults to a $5 cap, ultra to a $20 cap. Connect providers bill extra (Fiber.ai $0.02/credit; Baselayer $0.15–$4.00/order).

offerings.name: Enterprise plan
offerings.pricing: Custom pricing — volume discounts and postpaid invoice billing (talk to us)
offerings.output_type: Powerful search: up to 1,000 results per search; custom indexes
offerings.note: Includes SLAs/MSAs, 1:1 onboarding, Zero Data Retention, custom rate limits (QPS), tailored moderation, custom datasets. No subscription and no minimum spend for PAYG.
